title: Contrix Ephemeral Broadcast Envelope
description: Wire shape for broadcast ephemeral signals — cx.presence, cx.typing, cx.receipt.read, cx.call.signal. These signals have wire_scope=ephemeral_event in event-kind-registry.json: they MUST NOT carry preconditions / effects / anchor_ref, MUST NOT advance Anchor frontier or Move state_root or actor_seq, MUST NOT enter reducer state, and MUST NOT be submitted via cx.events.submit. They are carried on dedicated ephemeral channels (sync subscribe live stream, presence/typing fanout, call signaling channel) and are dropped at TTL. Point-to-point to-device signals (cx.key.verification.*) use device-message.schema.json instead — they have a sender+recipient pair and do not match this broadcast shape. See zh/sync/operations-sync.md §3.6 (wire-scope reject rule) and zh/crypto-media/webrtc-signaling.md §3 (ephemeral channel transport).

kind.description: Ephemeral signal kind. MUST be one of the four broadcast ephemeral kinds; cx.key.verification.* point-to-point flows MUST use device-message.schema.json instead.

realm_id.description: Realm whose ephemeral channel carries this signal. Authorization to broadcast a signal on a Realm channel is governed by the same membership / capability rules as the corresponding durable kinds.

actor_id.description: Signaling actor. MUST be a member of the Realm (cx.member.state cell join != ban/leave/remove at receive time) for the broadcast to be admitted by other clients; receivers drop signals from non-members without surfacing them.

device_id.description: Originating device. Optional but RECOMMENDED so receivers can dedupe per-device typing/presence signals.

sent_at.description: Wall-clock send time. Diagnostic only — ephemeral signals do not participate in HLC ordering.

expires_at.description: Server / client MUST drop the signal at or after this time. Per-kind soft caps (recommended): presence ≤ 60s, typing ≤ 15s, receipt.read ≤ 30s, call.signal ≤ 30s. Signals with expires_at > sent_at + 5 minutes MUST be dropped by receivers (`invalid_param`).

payload.description: Kind-specific signal payload. Schema per kind is defined by the producing module (e.g. zh/crypto-media/webrtc-signaling.md for cx.call.signal, zh/discovery/read-receipts.md for cx.receipt.read). Payload MUST NOT carry mutable governance state — that belongs in a durable event.

proof.description: Optional detached signature over canonical envelope bytes (per RFC 8785 JCS, excluding `proof` itself). Required for cx.call.signal in E2EE Realms; RECOMMENDED for cx.receipt.read so receivers can verify origin without trusting relay. presence / typing MAY omit proof for cost reasons; receivers MUST NOT promote unsigned signals to durable state.
